post.description: Explicit local manual review; original publication receipt and current authorization remain authoritative. Replies inherit the canonical root. Their existing path/root-comment identifier, optional targetReplyId and imageAssetIds handling already canonicalizes UUIDs to lowercase before constructing the inherited envelope; this rule does not impose a new lowercase-input rejection on replies. The v4-only check runs after original-key receipt recovery and before new Review submission or approval issuance. Legacy none input schemas, normalization and hash bytes are unchanged; never rewrite a frozen historical request to lowercase.

parameters.description: Existing reply handling canonicalizes the root-comment UUID to lowercase.
